005package org.wpilib.vision.apriltag;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Transform3d;
008
009/** A pair of AprilTag pose estimates. */
010public class AprilTagPoseEstimate {
011  /**
012   * Constructs a pose estimate.
013   *
014   * @param pose1 first pose
015   * @param pose2 second pose
016   * @param error1 error of first pose
017   * @param error2 error of second pose
018   */
019  public AprilTagPoseEstimate(Transform3d pose1, Transform3d pose2, double error1, double error2) {
020    this.pose1 = pose1;
021    this.pose2 = pose2;
022    this.error1 = error1;
023    this.error2 = error2;
024  }
025
026  /**
027   * Get the ratio of pose reprojection errors, called ambiguity. Numbers above 0.2 are likely to be
028   * ambiguous.
029   *
030   * @return The ratio of pose reprojection errors.
031   */
032  public double getAmbiguity() {
033    double min = Math.min(error1, error2);
034    double max = Math.max(error1, error2);
035
036    if (max > 0) {
037      return min / max;
038    } else {
039      return -1;
040    }
041  }
042
043  /** Pose 1. */
044  public final Transform3d pose1;
045
046  /** Pose 2. */
047  public final Transform3d pose2;
048
049  /** Object-space error of pose 1. */
050  public final double error1;
051
052  /** Object-space error of pose 2. */
053  public final double error2;
054}
